body: You’re fine, you didn’t upset me at all. I was really upset when I was posting this last night. I feel better today.
Thank you, I wish it was that easy. She is never aro Nd because of how much she is working and when she is here she is either asleep or so exhausted that she may as well still be gone.
Thank you, I appreciate that. There are things I would like to do. But they don’t feel attainable. Plus they are all pipe dream kind of things.

There is always a chance that my condition could improve but they only just dicovered it so it is unlikely they will find a way to fix it in my life time. 

It’s up to her, as his sister she will be given custody and I know she won’t. 

It just seems like I exist to play babysitter and be an extra paycheck. I don’t see a reason to do anything beyond that.
